claim.title: Zainab claims by voice, in Urdu
points: Voice in, voice out — every screen speaks; icons, not forms
Asks only for what is missing — the next question is chosen by code
Reads it back — she answers yes or no
Consent in plain words — nothing is pre-ticked
The AI never approves — rules decide; not sure → an officer
claim.foot: Real: Urdu speech recognition, language model, card scan. Works offline: the claim waits on the phone and is sent later.

scamask.kicker: On the phone · safety and answers
scamask.title: Is this message real? Ask the program
points: Scam check — paste any SMS; verdict with reasons, spoken aloud
Haqdaar Seal — genuine messages carry a code that breaks if one character changes
Ask with sources — answers come only from the published policy
Reports feed the Scam Map the admin sees
scamask.foot: If the AI is not sure, it says so and hands over to a person.

receipt.kicker: On the phone · the end of the task
receipt.title: Decision, payout, Haq Receipt
points: Where is my money? — status in simple words, spoken
Haq Receipt — the exact amount in digits and words
My data and consent — who sees what, and why
Take consent back at any time, in one tap
receipt.foot: Claim → decision → payout → receipt: the whole task, end to end.

helper.title: A trusted shopkeeper helps a family
points: The family's own PIN is needed every time
Acting-for banner — always shows whose claim this is
Everything is logged under the helper's name
helper.foot: The demo shows the PINs on screen; a real helper never sees them.
